title: First Relay Station
subtitle: The first major POI route after first-month survival
summary: The relay station is the selected 1.7.6 major route. It connects route records, Lens scans, HoloMap markers, PowerGrid repair, cache rewards, and optional Crashbreak field work.
body: The relay route is intentionally smaller than a bio lab or reactor ruin. It should teach the major-route pattern without jumping into late-game danger.
Before leaving, check weather, bring food and clean water, carry repair parts, and set a return marker.
At the POI, scan the relay console and power coupler. Repair if possible, then claim the relay cache and return to Terminal.
If repair input, status text, or route records are unclear, record it as a 1.7.6 smoke issue.
